headline: Week 9: The Massacre at Six Different Addresses
subhead: Not a single matchup decided by less than 28 points — this wasn't a slate, it was a war crime tribunal.
matchOfTheWeek: The Olave Garden didn't just beat Hot Cocks, they served them a 187-point tasting menu while Hot Cocks were still buttering their bread. Burrow, Achane, Kamara, Kelce, AND Zay Flowers all in one lineup is borderline illegal in 38 states. The funniest part? Hot Cocks ran a 98% efficient lineup — the most clinically optimized loss of the year.
mainRecap:
Week 9 wasn't competitive football, it was a public stoning. Six matchups, zero finishes inside 28 points, and the league collectively wondering if the schedule generator has a vendetta.

Let's start at the bottom of the toilet, where Bo Nix Celli put up a stately 89.50 — a number so embarrassing it should be illegal in a SuperFlex league. Justin Herbert dropped 19.48 on your bench, Nick. Did you forget you have a QB slot? Two of them? Meanwhile you're trading away picks for nothing, just rearranging deck chairs on a yacht that never left the harbor.

LargestofRocks won by 59 and still has the audacity to be the week's most negligent GM. DeAndre Hopkins (28.6), Daniel Jones (24.36), AND Quentin Johnston (22) — that's 75 points rotting on your bench while you put up 179. Imagine being THIS rich and this stupid simultaneously. OnlyFants got steamrolled despite Garrett Wilson going for 30; Cubby, your WR1 is begging for help and you're sending in JAGs.

The Good Ladds deserve their own circle of hell — losing by 62 to 226 Alpha while leaving 44.38 points on the bench, headlined by Demarcus Robinson going for 27.4 in street clothes. Mig, Hurts dropped 29.90 on Szara's side and your guys were busy losing the matchup AND the lineup-setting contest. 226 Alpha is just rolling now.

Stroud Boys squeaked out the "closest" game of the week (28 points lol) thanks to JSN's 37-burger, while Put an AR to My Head wasted a 32.9 from Saquon. Kyle, you got a Saquon ceiling game and still couldn't crack 100 — that's a special kind of malpractice. T swift's Baddies hung 151 on Bo Nix to remind everyone they exist, and MassiveCocks rode a 29.5 from Mike Gesicki, of all people, to handle Jets' Juniors. Mattwunder, your team got Geseckied. Process that.
